## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

No issues found in the tested scope.

**Verified:** the Elsewhen globe's tilt reaches the new condition, and glyphs at right angles keep their existing render path.

- Elsewhen's bar button sets `textRotation: Solar.AXIAL_TILT` (23.44, from `GlobeModel.js`), and `BarIconButton` passes it to `OpticalGlyph.rotation`. A headless run of the real `shell/Ui` components read back the resulting state:

  | `rotation` | head `layer.enabled` | base `layer.enabled` | head vs base pixels (scale 1) |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 23.44 (Elsewhen-like) | true (`layer.smooth` true) | false | differ (resampled) |
  | 0 (upright) | false | false | identical |
  | 90 (tray-like chevron) | false | false | identical |

- The condition keeps the layer off at 0, ±90, ±180, 270, 360 and 450 (`-90 % 90` is `-0`, which compares equal to `0`), and turns it on for negative and fractional angles such as -23.44 and 0.5. The polkit agent and the vertical clock use `OpticalGlyph` without setting `rotation`, so they are unaffected.
- In Qt 6.11.2 source, native text samples the glyph cache with nearest filtering and snaps vertices to the pixel grid, which is why it breaks up off-axis. The layer renders the glyph unrotated into a texture of the item's size times the device pixel ratio, then rotates that texture with linear filtering (`layer.smooth`). The texture size tracks the device pixel ratio, so the source indicates HiDPI stays sharp.
- The layer captures only the item's own box. For both globes (the current Font Awesome glyph and the Material earth from omacom/elsewhen#7), the ink stays inside the icon canvas (16 px at the default size, scaled with the font) at every font base size from 8 to 24 with JetBrainsMono Nerd Font (from font metrics; pixel-checked at the default size), so nothing is clipped and the two PRs do not depend on merge order.

**Note for future rotated glyphs:** because only the item's box is captured, glyph ink outside the canvas is cut off when the layer is on, and a rotated `OpticalGlyph` with no explicit size renders nothing (the root has no implicit size). No current caller is affected. A sentence in the code comment would make this visible.

**Optional:** only rotation set on `OpticalGlyph` itself is smoothed. A text button using `WidgetButton.textRotation` rotates its plain `label` Text, which still uses native rendering, so an off-angle text label would stay jagged. Rotation applied to an ancestor or through `transform` is not covered either. No caller in this repository or Elsewhen does any of this today.

**Related PR:** open omacom/omarchy#8830 rewrites `OpticalGlyph.qml`, `BarIconButton.qml` and `WidgetButton.qml`. In its version, `textRotation` rotates an ancestor `Row` instead of setting `OpticalGlyph.rotation`, so the `rotation % 90` condition here would not see the Elsewhen tilt if that structure is kept when the two are reconciled.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** pinned head `76c09e6` against base `c5b4db7`, with the Elsewhen caller read at its main branch and at omacom/elsewhen#7. Rendering ran offscreen in an isolated runtime on Qt 6.11.2 with the software backend, because no GPU was available. That backend does not reproduce the jagged native rendering, so the smoothing itself was established from Qt source, not observed on screen. Pixel comparisons use scale 1 only, and HiDPI behavior rests on source. `test/shell.d/bar-icon-geometry-test.sh` needs a compositor and was not run; it checks rotation 0 only.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
